Subject: Q3 calibration: urgent tier discrepancy and next-step plan

Team —

During the final pass on Q3 calibration I flagged a notable cross-team discrepancy for IC: Sarah M. (Acme Health engagement) was placed Tier 1 by Product but appears Tier 3 in Platform. The variance is material: it affects comp and an ongoing promotion conversation. I pulled the evidence we have into a packet (attached) and highlighted where manager anchors diverge.

Key asks:
- Laura: can you sanity-check the Platform rationale and point to the specific behaviors / evidence driving the lower placement?
- Vivek: given this touches comp/promo, do we need to pull HR formally in this cadence or can we resolve at leadership calibration?
- Neha: if we need HR, please advise on the minimal evidence set and timeline for an appeals window.

I propose a rapid triage meeting today (30 min) to see if we can reach consensus before comp letters go out Monday. If not, we escalate to HR and freeze adjustments.

Attachments: evidence_packet_q3.pdf (compiled notes, manager anchors), manager_anchor_notes.xlsx

Thanks,
Priyom

Thanks Priyom — quick reply. I reviewed the Platform packet and my notes are in manager_anchor_notes.xlsx (attached):

- Platform assessments leaned on sustained cross-service ownership and incident leadership across three quarters. The evidence spreadsheet ties specific incidents to the reduced rating (see rows 12-18).
- Product's Tier 1 placement focused on demo impact and stakeholder advocacy for the Acme pilot; those are valid but are shorter-term outcome signals.
- My read is this is a definitional difference in signal weighting, not a clear error. That said, the comp/promo sensitivity makes this higher stakes than a typical split.

If we run a 30-min sync now, I can share screen and walk the incident timeline vs. product outcomes. If we still don't converge, I agree with Vivek that HR should be looped to document the outcome.

Laura
Director, Platform Engineering

Appreciate the flag. Two quick notes: 

1) Because this links to a pending promotion, we should err on the side of documented process and HR visibility. I recommend we open a short HR advisory case (no action yet) so all dialogue is recorded. That preserves flexibility while protecting the employee.

2) Neha — I think we need the minimal evidence set Priyom referenced (manager anchors + incident log + product outcomes). Can you confirm whether the evidence_packet_q3.pdf meets HR's baseline? If not, what else do we need and what is the deadline to avoid delaying comp letters?

I’m available for a 30-min triage at 2:00pm PT today. Priyom / Laura, if that works, please book and invite Anita Shah from TalentAdvise (external HR consultant) as optional — she can help mediate definitions and ensure calibrations align to market norms.

— Vivek

On Fri, Sep 5, 2027 at 11:03 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I recommend we open a short HR advisory case (no action yet) so all dialogue is recorded.

Thanks everyone — following the triage we ran Friday afternoon (notes uploaded to the Drive link), here's the decision and next steps we agreed on: 

Summary decision: Leadership calibration will finalize a Tier 2 placement with a documented development plan (captures both cross-service ownership and product impact). We will not retroactively change comp offers this cycle; instead, we will provide the employee a formal feedback packet and a targeted promotion milestone to be revisited at the November calibration.

Records & evidence: HR accepted the evidence_packet_q3.pdf as the baseline. Anita (TalentAdvise) and Acme HR were looped and recorded their advisory notes in the shared Drive doc (link below).

Action items (owners / deadlines):
- Priyom: finalize the development milestones and manager coaching notes by 2027-09-10.
- Laura: add incident-specific improvement goals to the manager anchor sheet by 2027-09-10.
- Neha: draft the feedback packet and one-page promotion milestone plan; circulate to Anita and Acme HR for acknowledgement by 2027-09-12.
- Vivek: confirm no change to comp letters for this cycle and sign off on the communication plan by 2027-09-12.

Appeals window: HR will accept formal appeals with new evidence through 2027-09-19. If an appeal is filed, we will pause final comp disbursement for the employee until resolved.

Links: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/open?id=ghx-ACME-q3-evidence, JIRA HR-7890
